commands.review_summary:
The PR hardens RunPod acquire/resolve/release ownership checks, adds exact claim binding and live-smoke coverage, and updates RunPod stop/provider documentation plus release-note text.

Reproducibility: yes. by source inspection: current main's RunPod release path can terminate from stored provider identity without the exact resource-bound claim recheck, and the PR code path for the remaining legacy reclaim bug is traceable through claim lookup and write behavior. I did not run destructive live RunPod validation in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] Human PR handling is still needed because the branch has a concrete legacy reclaim compatibility blocker and the remaining live RunPod proof cannot be supplied by an automated repair lane.

target.title: fix: bind RunPod release to exact claims
target.body:
## Summary

- bind RunPod destructive operations to exact local claims containing provider ID and pod name
- require explicit `--reclaim` adoption for unclaimed or legacy pods; never silently retarget an existing claim
- re-read the pod under the release lock and verify both ID and name before deletion
- reject ambiguous exact, normalized-name, derived-lease, local-slug/provider-ID, and local-slug/pod-name lookups
- preserve exact created-pod identity through readiness-failure cleanup
- add a cleanup-armed, isolated-state RunPod live lifecycle canary and top-level live-smoke dispatch

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/801

## Verification

Current candidate: `257437dc9b534fba064e1931fa6727392f21d792`

- `go test -race ./internal/providers/runpod ./internal/cli -count=1` — pass.
- `go vet ./internal/providers/runpod ./internal/cli` — pass.
- `node --test scripts/live-runpod-smoke.test.js scripts/live-smoke.test.js` — 59 tests pass, including cleanup, secret-redaction, non-empty-inventory refusal, dispatch, and both alias-collision forms.
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — pass; 53 command docs, 71 provider-matrix rows, 209 Markdown files, generated docs site.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — pass.
- Full-branch autoreview — clean; no accepted/actionable findings (0.84).

## Pre-merge live gate

Both concealed fields in the approved stored RunPod E2E item were tested without exposing their values. The `api_key` field reaches RunPod but `doctor --provider runpod` returns HTTP 401; the legacy `credential` field is empty. The isolated canary made no provider mutation and left zero residue.

Keep this PR unmerged until the stored key is replaced and `scripts/live-runpod-smoke.sh` proves real pod create, SSH command execution, exact-claim stop, and zero-residue inventory cleanup; alternatively record an explicit item-specific waiver.

## Security / configuration

No new persisted-secret requirement. The live canary accepts `CRABBOX_RUNPOD_API_KEY` or `RUNPOD_API_KEY` only from the process environment and isolates its Crabbox state.
